name: core.openwop.workflows.knowledge
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0190 Phase 2) — the internal Knowledge cluster: employee policy/HR Q&A grounded in your Knowledge Base, compliance review of documents against your policy corpus, and structured document summarization. Distinct from core.openwop.workflows.support: these serve EMPLOYEES over internal policy collections. Authored over shipped node typeIds (feature.kb.nodes.rag + core.ai.chatCompletion + core.flow.if + core.chat.approvalGate + core.openwop.integration.*). Populate the collections in the Knowledge feature — these chains READ the app KB. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). EVERY delivery edge is PORT-QUALIFIED (ADR 0583) — a bare edge binds no named port at all. Every external send waits on a human approval gate AND ONLY FIRES ON AN APPROVAL — Slack takes its content BACK OFF THE GATE (`approveEscalation.artifact → escalate.text`, `{truthy approved}`), so it has NO unconditional incoming edge and every non-approving outcome folds it to `skipped`.
author: openwop

chains.label: HR & Policy Q&A Agent
chains.description: Answer an employee's policy or HR question grounded ONLY in your internal policy docs (Knowledge Base), citing the specific policy sections. Covered questions are answered as a notification CARRYING THE ANSWER TEXT (`route.value → deliver.message`); questions your policies don't cover route to a human-approved escalation to your people team instead of guessing — the approver SEES the answer (`route.value → approveEscalation.artifact`) and the Slack escalation takes that same content BACK OFF THE GATE (`approveEscalation.artifact → escalate.text`, conditioned `{truthy approved}`). That is the whole gate: reject, time out, or ask for changes and `escalate`'s only upstream folds to `skipped`, so the uncovered-policy answer never reaches #people-ops. Add policy docs under Knowledge to ground it.

orgId.description: The org whose knowledge base is searched. Must be the same org the collection belongs to, or nothing is found.

collectionId.description: The KB collection id to search (create via the Knowledge feature or knowledge-sync).

escalationChannel.description: Slack channel for questions the policy corpus does not cover.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are an internal HR/policy assistant answering an EMPLOYEE. Answer using ONLY the retrieved policy passages, citing the specific policy/section for every statement. Never speculate about policy. If the passages do not cover the question, say exactly that. End with 'COVERED: yes' or 'COVERED: no'. Question: {{params.query}}

config.title: Approve escalating this uncovered policy question

chains.label: Compliance Review vs Your Policies
chains.description: Check a document (contract clause, marketing copy, announcement) against your internal policies: retrieve the relevant ones from the Knowledge Base, flag every deviation with the policy it conflicts with, and route flagged documents to a human-approved compliance escalation. Clean documents notify you WITH the review text (`route.value → pass.message`); flagged ones show the reviewer the deviation list (`route.value → approveEscalation.artifact`) and Slack receives that list BACK OFF THE GATE (`approveEscalation.artifact → escalate.text`, conditioned `{truthy approved}`) — so a rejected, timed-out or sent-back review posts nothing to #compliance.

query.description: What to search the policy library for — usually the document text itself, or a summary of it. Kept separate from the document being reviewed.

orgId.description: The org whose knowledge base is searched. Must be the same org the collection belongs to, or nothing is found.

collectionId.description: The KB collection id to search (create via the Knowledge feature or knowledge-sync).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are a compliance reviewer. Compare the document below against ONLY the retrieved policy passages. List every deviation as: the document statement, the policy it conflicts with (cite the section), and the risk. If nothing conflicts, say the document passes. End with 'FLAGS: <count>'. Document: {{params.documentText}}

chains.label: Document Summarizer
chains.description: Turn a long document into a structured summary — purpose, key points, decisions/asks, and open questions — delivered as a notification whose BODY is the summary (`summarize.content → notify.message`). Paste the text (or pipe it from another workflow) and get the two-minute version.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: Summarize the document below into: Purpose (1 line) · Key points (bullets) · Decisions or asks · Open questions. Be faithful — do not add information. Document: {{params.documentText}}
